label: Eureka route/view/representation matrix
description: Contract-only Track A matrix binding canonical route families to canonical view-model families, representation profiles, host exposure defaults, semantic parity policies, current status, and deferred behavior.

route_families.label: Home
route_families.description: Static public overview route family.
route_families.current_surface_status: Implemented as committed static HTML under site/dist.
no_goals: no dynamic hosted homepage behavior
notes: Uses inherited public-page parity until a HomePage-specific parity policy exists.

route_families.label: Search
route_families.description: Public search route family covering static handoff and local/prototype HTML runtime search.
route_families.current_surface_status: Static handoff is implemented at /search.html; local/prototype runtime is implemented at /search. Hosted search is not active.
future_artifacts: Track E hosted public alpha search, operator-gated
no_goals: no hosted dynamic search activation
notes: Representation profile choice must not create /old/search or /mobile/search route identities.

route_families.label: API search
route_families.description: Local/prototype public-search JSON route family.
route_families.current_surface_status: Implemented only for local/prototype local_index_only runtime. Not hosted and not production API.
future_artifacts: Track E hosted backend route after operator evidence
no_goals: no hosted API activation
notes: API alias exposure is JSON-only for this matrix milestone.

route_families.label: Query plan
route_families.description: Local/prototype deterministic query-plan API route family.
route_families.current_surface_status: Implemented only for local/prototype local_index_only runtime.
future_artifacts: Track E hosted backend route after operator evidence
no_goals: no live query fanout
notes: Uses search-page parity for query status, limits, and disabled capability posture.

route_families.label: Status
route_families.description: Public status and capability-summary route family.
route_families.current_surface_status: Static status page exists; local/prototype API status also exists. Hosted status remains unverified.
future_artifacts: Track E hosted status only after operator evidence
no_goals: no private diagnostics or telemetry
notes: Status remains public-safe and read-only across profiles.

route_families.label: Sources
route_families.description: Public source-list summary route family.
route_families.current_surface_status: Static source summary exists; local/prototype API source list exists.
no_goals: no source connector runtime
notes: Source summaries are not source trust authority.

route_families.label: Source detail
route_families.description: Local/prototype public-safe source detail route family.
route_families.current_surface_status: Implemented only for local/prototype API source detail.
no_goals: no source proxy or live source probe
notes: Detailed source pages remain future outside the local API summary.

route_families.label: Future object page
route_families.description: Future public object page route family.
route_families.current_surface_status: Contract-only future page. No runtime route exists.
no_goals: no object route activation

route_families.label: Future need page

route_families.label: Future snapshot

route_families.label: Future relay

route_families.label: Future native card

Conservative public-page parity for status, warnings, disabled capabilities, and limitations.
Search page parity is direct.
Search API currently inherits search-page semantic obligations.
Query plan inherits search status and limitation parity.
Status inherits disabled-capability and limitation parity.
Source-list view inherits source-page source posture rules.
Source detail parity is direct.
Object page parity is direct.
Need page parity is direct.
Candidate page parity is direct.
Pack page parity is direct.
Task page parity is direct.
Review page parity is direct.
Evidence pages inherit source/evidence posture until a dedicated policy exists.
Absence page parity is direct.
Comparison pages inherit object identity/evidence parity until a dedicated policy exists.
Manifest parity is direct.
Static data inherits manifest/source/checksum parity.
Lite static pages inherit public-page parity obligations.
Text static pages inherit public-page parity obligations.
File-tree surface uses manifest parity directly.
Demo pages inherit result-card parity for fixture-backed examples.
Snapshots inherit manifest parity until a dedicated snapshot parity policy exists.
Relay capability manifests inherit manifest parity until Track D.
Native cards inherit object parity until a dedicated native-card parity policy exists.
This matrix is contract/governance only.
Host and representation profiles select projections; they do not change route identity.
Hosted public alpha remains Track E and operator-gated.
The matrix intentionally uses inherited semantic parity bindings for route/view families that Track A-02 did not specialize.
